dict.string: Spottr uses your camera to count reps and show movement cues on this iPhone. Video stays on your device.
Spottr listens for rep numbers only when you choose spoken counting. Audio is processed on this iPhone.
Spottr recognises rep numbers on this iPhone when you enable spoken counting. Manual entry is always available.

When you choose Apple Health, Spottr reads existing resting and walking heart rate, SDNN heart rate variability, cardio fitness, heart rate recovery, blood oxygen, respiratory rate, steps and walking/running distance to show dated summaries on this iPhone. These readings are optional and are not uploaded or added to recorded workouts.
Spottr’s companion Apple Watch app saves a strength workout to Apple Health only when you choose to record it. The iPhone reads optional Health summaries.
Spottr connects to your local workout gateway.
